text:
Insoluble solid magnesium carbonate reacts with dilute sulfuric acid.
The equation is shown.
magnesium carbonate + sulfuric acid → magnesium sulfate + water + carbon dioxide
The steps used to make crystals of magnesium sulfate are listed.
step 1
Add excess magnesium carbonate to dilute sulfuric acid and stir the mixture.
step 2
Filter the mixture.
step 3
Heat the filtrate to the point of crystallisation.
step 4
Leave the filtrate to cool.
What is the residue removed from the mixture in step 2?
A
magnesium carbonate
B
sulfuric acid
C
magnesium sulfate
D
water
